meta.title: eRFX project level (all stages), one clause Required: the vendor accepts both clauses

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Set the project title required for publishing.
Configure the project with RFQ only.
Configure the RFQ stage.
Apply the RFQ pricing template.
Add the requested cylinder item with quantity 10.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.

args.goal: on the RFQ create screen, set the line item's Delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001), open Add T&Cs, add clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set the first clause to Required and leave the second clause as None, click Done, and stop with both configured clauses visible

steps.note: Configure the exact delivery location and project-level clauses, which have no dedicated catalog step.
Verify the required project-level clause is visible after configuration.
Verify the optional project-level clause is visible after configuration.
Invite one QA vendor to the RFQ.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured RFQ project.
Verify publishing reached a real project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open this event's RFQ pricing round as the vendor.
Verify the vendor sees the required project-level clause.
Verify the vendor sees the optional project-level clause.
Accept the required clause.
Accept the optional clause.
Submit a quote of 100 after accepting both clauses.
Verify the vendor bid was submitted successfully.
